items.title: Ahaziah of Judah
items.charge: Walking in the ways of the house of Ahab, his mother being his counsellor to do wickedly

items.title: Amalek
items.charge: Attacking Israel's stragglers on the way out of Egypt

items.title: Babylon, the lady of kingdoms
items.charge: Showing no mercy to the captives; saying, I am, and none else beside me; trusting in her sorceries

items.title: Ben-hadad and the Syrians at Aphek
items.charge: Saying the Lord is a god of the hills and not of the valleys

items.title: Chorazin, Bethsaida, and Capernaum
items.charge: Not repenting after the mighty works done in them

items.title: David's numbering of the people
items.charge: Numbering Israel in pride; a plague on the nation

items.title: Edom, in the day of his brother
items.charge: Standing on the other side when strangers carried Jacob away; rejoicing over Judah's fall; cutting off those that escaped

items.title: Israel and the fiery serpents
items.charge: Speaking against God and against Moses; loathing the bread from heaven

items.title: Israel at Baal-peor
items.charge: Fornication with the daughters of Moab; sacrificing to their gods

items.title: Jehoiachin (Coniah)
items.charge: Doing evil as his father Jehoiakim had done; a signet plucked from the Lord's right hand

items.title: Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets
items.charge: Killing the prophets and stoning them that are sent; not knowing the time of her visitation

items.title: Johanan and the remnant that went down to Egypt
items.charge: Asking the word of the Lord, swearing to obey it, and refusing it; burning incense to the queen of heaven in Egypt

items.title: Moab and Ammon
items.charge: Magnifying themselves against the Lord and against his people; rejoicing over the sanctuary when it was profaned

items.title: Nazareth, his own country
items.charge: Being offended at him; seeking to cast him down the hill

items.title: Nineveh under Jonah
items.charge: Wickedness come up before the Lord

items.title: Nineveh under Nahum
items.charge: A bloody city, full of lies and robbery, mistress of witchcrafts

items.title: Pharaoh of the Exodus
items.charge: Oppressing Israel; drowning their sons; refusing the Lord's command

items.title: Pharaoh-hophra and Egypt
items.charge: Saying, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself; a staff of reed to the house of Israel

items.title: Saul's house and the Gibeonites
items.charge: Breaking Israel's sworn covenant by slaying the Gibeonites

items.title: Sennacherib and Rabshakeh
items.charge: Reproaching the living God; setting him among the gods of the nations that could not save

items.title: Sihon and Og
items.charge: Refusing Israel passage and coming out to battle against them

items.title: Sodom and Gomorrah
items.charge: Grievous sin; inhospitality and violence against strangers

items.title: The builders of Babel
items.charge: Building a tower to make themselves a name and resist being scattered

items.title: The captivity of Israel (the northern kingdom)
items.charge: Two centuries of the sins of Jeroboam; secret sins; idols, high places, and children through the fire

items.title: The captivity of Judah
items.charge: Polluting the house of the Lord; mocking the messengers of God; refusing the Sabbath and the land's sabbaths

items.title: The complainers at Taberah and the lusters at Kibroth-hattaavah
items.charge: Murmuring against the Lord; lusting after flesh and despising the manna

items.title: The congregation, the day after Korah
items.charge: Murmuring that Moses and Aaron had killed the people of the Lord

items.title: The Corinthians at the Lord's supper
items.charge: Eating and drinking unworthily; shaming them that have not

items.title: The elders with idols in the temple (Ezekiel 8)
items.charge: The image of jealousy; creeping things on the walls; women weeping for Tammuz; twenty-five men worshipping the sun with their backs to the temple

items.title: The generation of the Flood
items.charge: Corruption and violence filling the earth

items.title: The generation that died in the wilderness
items.charge: Ten provocations; unbelief at Kadesh-barnea

items.title: The Hellenizers who forsook the holy covenant
items.charge: Covenanting with the heathen; removing circumcision; profaning the Sabbath; sacrificing to idols

items.title: The men of Gibeah, and Benjamin
items.charge: Sodomy, gang rape and murder of a stranger's concubine; a tribe that shielded the guilty

items.title: The Midianites, in the matter of Peor
items.charge: Beguiling Israel with their wiles into fornication and the worship of Baal-peor

items.title: The Philistines and the captured ark
items.charge: Setting the ark of God in the house of Dagon, and keeping it seven months

items.title: The prince of Tyre
items.charge: Saying, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God

items.title: The scribes and Pharisees
items.charge: Shutting up the kingdom against men; devouring widows' houses; tithing mint and omitting judgment, mercy and faith; whited sepulchres

items.title: The sons of God and the giants
items.charge: Leaving their proper estate; taking wives of the daughters of men
